And as to my feelings to the series ending, i never did a reread, and ive never read new spring. I'm just now rereading EotW and loving it. Knowing all the secrets you can see right a way the unbelievable layers and complexity, like Ishamael in the Prologue blinking into Lews Therrins palace, that was a true power gatway, 6 books before the True Power is introduced as a concept. There won't be anymore books, but the series isn't over, it's a brave new world.
